about_the_game:
UNGALAND combines action-adventure, and platforming with exploring a vast, cartoon-styled world to discover the island is full of life and surprises at every corner. Explore the different paths packed with enemies and get ready to face them head-on with a WILD arsenal of weapons only you can wield.

THE ISLAND IS CRAZY

Conquer the dangers deep within the island of Wa-Kabum and uncover the mysteries hidden by overcoming each trial thrown your way; it’s up to you to face these dangers head-on and return victorious Not as the Hero they seek, but as the Brute they need.

UNGALAND! FEATURES

An Exciting Gameplay Experience 

Become Oogie and face the various enemies in challenging hand-to-hand combat, relying on his reflexes to block and dodge the enemy attacks to defeat them to earn resources or new equipment. This allows players to upgrade their attributes, explore new paths on the map, and unlock new treasures to find!

Amazing Abilities

As you explore the land of Wa-Kabum, you’ll encounter Primal Seeds; using these seeds will allow different upgrades to your equipped weapon, making each battle unique.

Explode, freeze, teleport, black holes—Oogie can do it all! And with you by his side, the sky is the limit! Create the craziest combinations to discover the world around you!

Dynamic Levels 

The levels will offer you many paths to explore freely and uncover all the rewards that only the bravest (or the most reckless) would dare to seek. However, tread carefully and be ready to face the enemies and traps of Wa-Kabum Island. Do you have what it takes to uncover the truth behind the island?
